selected_evidence.requirement: Identify current curl version and confirm an upgrade candidate exists (making the hold meaningful)
selected_evidence.summary: curl-8.17.0-r1 was installed; apk update showed curl 8.22.0-r0 upstream and apk upgrade --simulate listed curl as upgradable before the pin was applied.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pin curl in /etc/apk/world to its current version
selected_evidence.summary: Backed up /etc/apk/world and rewrote the 'curl' entry to 'curl=8.17.0-r1'.

selected_evidence.requirement: Prove the hold prevents curl from being upgraded
selected_evidence.summary: apk upgrade --simulate no longer listed curl/libcurl; a real apk upgrade of 133 packages left curl at 8.17.0-r1 (confirmed via apk info/apk list and curl --version) while other packages upgraded.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id f27bb0ed-2dfc-42fb-a0ca-47296914ff4f and boot time 2026-09-29 09:52:59 as baseline, with curl already pinned and healthy.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect, node restarted one at a time
selected_evidence.summary: Issued a backgrounded native 'reboot' on node1 so the exec call returned successfully before the node disconnected; only node1 was targeted.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: changed boot identity proves an actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: After polling through connection resets/timeouts, node1 came back with boot_id 7ba884c4-44fe-42cb-8a6f-4324e06dced7 and new boot time 2026-09-29 09:54:34, differing from baseline.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: post-restart recovery of curl hold and functionality
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, curl-8.17.0-r1/libcurl-8.17.0-r1 remained installed, the world-file pin persisted, curl successfully performed an HTTPS request, and a fresh apk update + upgrade --simulate still excluded curl from any upgrade.
